purpose: Consolidate which registry is authoritative for each part of Potato House navigation so planes, Trees, Rooms, seeds, spirals, entities and pages can grow without duplicating or contradicting one another.

authorities.rule: Defines the Potato of Life as semantic center, distinguishes it from Axis as spatial center, and governs center-out importance rings and promotion.
Binds development waves, core operator pairings, Room contributions, living systems, tests and public composition without replacing canonical owners.
Standardizes local centers for Dwellings, Rooms, surfaces and artifacts while preserving Potato as semantic center and Axis as global spatial center.
Defines how mature Works declare source Rooms, Fruit types, intended effects, reception, risks and future Seed without equating completion/popularity with success.
Governs additive, narrowing, strengthening, reinterpretive, corrective, superseding and retraction revisions while preserving prior states/provenance.
Defines non-owning lenses that reinterpret center-native material without creating Rooms, planes or realms.
Coordinates organism, Spirit/relation, memory/history and culture/formation across existing Room owners without creating replacement ownership.
Defines the ten canonical knowledge-owning Dwellings.
Defines the 38 mature nested Rooms and their boundaries.
Assigns substantive repository knowledge to primary Rooms.
Defines high-level plane/compass projection, not detailed route mechanics.
Defines operators such as Door, Axis, Root, Tree, Spiral, Fruit, Garden and Swamp and their typed relations.
Projects governed Rooms and sparse landmarks into navigation slices.
Decides how Life, Strife, Repair, Roots, trunk and canopy cross Heaven/World/Below.
Decides C_S Seed Junction, Seed of Death/Life, Rooting, Drain, Sprouting, Repair, Return and Ring.
Defines transition states, flow behavior and finer vertical projection.
Curates named subjects with own-tradition anchors, Room placement, plane projections, Tree affinities and repository sources.
Defines sourced structural correspondences and anti-conspiracy boundaries for Providence, Great Seal pyramid, Jachin/Boaz and 1776.
Classifies whether a symbol is plane, terrain, regime, organism, material state, threshold, perceptual layer, process, route or inhabitant before spatial/moral interpretation.
Operationally resolves category, Room, plane, Tree/route affinity, corridors, boundaries and visibility for new subjects before they are promoted into curated atlases.
Explains the whole architecture but should reference—not silently override—the machine-readable owners above.

resolver_order: 0. Ask how the subject relates to the Potato of Life project center; centrality is semantic/structural, not file-volume or novelty.
0.5. Use project-synthesis to pair the subject with its center contribution, Room owner, handoffs, tests and public route before adding another registry.
1. Identify the subject's canonical Room owner.
2. Identify own-tradition / historical source context before project comparison.
3. Add plane projection: Heaven, World, Below or crosscutting.
4. Add Tree zone or route affinity: roots, trunk, Life, Strife, canopy, repair, return.
5. Add Seed/Spiral route only if the subject genuinely participates in burial, recurrence, rooting, ascent, drain, repair or return.
6. Add corridor relations to neighboring Rooms/subjects.
7. Choose visibility: landmark, room-detail or archive-only.
8. Pages render from these registries; page copy is explanatory, not a competing authority.

spatial_grammar.corridor: typed relation between Rooms or subjects

anti_duplication_rules: Prefer extending a Room dossier or project-synthesis pairing over creating another master map.
Comparative and external subjects should point inward to project-native nodes rather than becoming parallel centers.
Do not create a new registry when an existing authority can be extended cleanly.
Do not copy detailed route sequences into topology.json when tree-plane-routing or seed-spiral-routing owns them.
Do not make named religious figures into new Rooms; they are subjects/inhabitants indexed into existing Rooms.
Do not assign moral essence from vertical placement.
Do not let public page layout become ontology.
A comparative resemblance never becomes historical identity or influence without source evidence.
